name: Spec-Alignment
description: The Source of Truth. Ensure draft matches project specifications, RFCs, or ADRs. Prune feature creep.

name: TDD-Compliance
description: The Verification Loop. Enforce Red -> Green -> Refactor. Ensure every line of logic is justified by a passing test.

name: Implementation Rigor
description: The Quality Standard. Apply 'elegant just-enough' philosophy. Enforce general-coding skill rules.

name: Compliance Audit
description: The Zero-Violation Filter. Full file re-read. Ensure zero rule violations block landing.
